metadata.description: Starts playback only if stopped or paused. Does nothing if already playing or recording. Safe for Stream Deck transport buttons.

version.author: BSK Apps
version.changelog: Says why it cannot play when the audio device is not running, instead of doing nothing. Pressing it again while it runs no longer asks whether to stop it.

metadata.description: Pauses if playing, unpauses if paused. Does nothing if stopped or recording. Safe for Stream Deck transport buttons.

version.author: BSK Apps
version.changelog: Pressing it again while it runs no longer asks whether to stop it.

metadata.description: Starts recording only if not already recording. Safe for Stream Deck transport buttons.

version.author: BSK Apps
version.changelog: After it starts recording, every track is unselected, so a fader or mute you touch mid-show moves only that track. Says why it cannot record when the audio device is not running, instead of doing nothing. Pressing it again while it runs no longer asks whether to stop it.

metadata.description: Imports track names from a CSV or text file. Handles sectioned console exports (dLive, Avantis, SQ), standard CSV (Yamaha CL, QL, Rivage) and plain text. On run it asks whether to rename existing tracks or create new ones.

version.author: BSK Apps
version.changelog: Shows the names it found before it changes anything. Refuses to run while recording. In console exports, blank rows keep their place, so the names below them no longer shift up. Accented names from Mac exports come through correctly.

reapack.name: BSK_AutoName_From_Inputs.lua
reapack.desc: BSK Auto-name: Tracks from Device Inputs

metadata.description: Names each track from the input label your audio interface reports for its input. Shows the names first and applies them only after you confirm. If your interface has no labels, use Import Track Names instead.

reapack.name: BSK_Colour_Tracks_By_Name.lua
reapack.desc: BSK Auto Color: Colour Tracks by Name

metadata.description: Opens the Auto Color window: groups of words (vocals, drums, bass, guitars and more) each with a colour and an optional icon. Apply to Tracks colours every track whose name has one of a group's words. Edit, add or remove groups to suit your desk. One undo.

Patches every track 1:1 to mono hardware inputs and outputs: track 1 to input 1 and output 1, and so on. Tracks past what your interface has keep what they have. For stereo tracks use BSK AutoPatch: HW 1-to-1 Mono and Stereo.

version.author: BSK Apps
version.changelog: Added a confirmation prompt at start: mono tracks only. A stereo track patches one channel, not both.

version.author: BSK Apps
version.changelog: Fixed: each track's hardware output now goes to its own single output. Before, it also spilled into the next output, so output 2 carried tracks 1 and 2. While recording, it now refuses to run instead of repatching tracks mid-show.

version.author: BSK Apps
version.changelog: Now patches inputs and outputs only. Pre-FX outputs, monitoring off and master send off moved to BSK AutoRoute: HW Pre FX. Before you patch, the box says which tracks your interface has no inputs or outputs for. Those tracks keep what they have. Refuses to run while playing.

metadata.description: Asks first, then removes every track's hardware inputs and outputs and turns master send and record monitoring back on. The opposite of AutoPatch.

version.author: BSK Apps
version.changelog: Asks before it removes anything. Refuses to run while playing or recording.

reapack.name: BSK_AutoPatch_HW_1to1_Mono_Stereo.lua
reapack.desc: BSK AutoPatch: HW 1-to-1 Mono and Stereo

metadata.description: Patches every track 1:1 to hardware inputs and outputs, mono and stereo. Set a track's input to stereo first and it takes the next pair of inputs and outputs; the tracks after it move along. Tracks past what your interface has come out blank (no input or output), so nothing doubles up, and a stereo one comes back stereo on a bigger interface.
For every track that has a hardware output: outputs pre FX and pre fader, record monitoring off, master send off. Run it after AutoPatch for virtual soundcheck.

reapack.name: BSK_Reset_Volume_Pan_Outputs.lua
reapack.desc: BSK Reset: Volume, Pan and Outputs

metadata.description: Asks first, then sets every track's fader to 0 dB and pan to centre, every hardware output to 0 dB and centre, and every item and take to 0 dB. One undo. Needs the SWS extension.
